subject: Pop-Up Lounge Activation & Crew Checklist (floorplan sign-off needed)
thread_text:
From: Emily Huang <emily@greenhall-events.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pop-up lounge draft layout + shared crew checklist

Hi Karthik + Marissa,

Thanks for walking the space with me last week. Attached is floorplan v3 for the pop-up lounge adjacent to Booth C12 (PDF attached). We carved out a 20x12ft carpeted lounge footprint that sits between the main aisle and demo island — the plan includes:
- Two high-back sofas (no open flames/pyrotechnics)
- One demo pedestal for quick 5-min product highlights (facing inward)
- Two charging islands (USB-C + wireless pads) tied to AV power drops
- Branding walls: 36" tall back skirted counter with a 6ft branded banner behind the sofas

Key items for Redwood sign-off:
1) Furniture placement & traffic flow (we want to avoid blocking the neighboring booth entrance)
2) Signage size: vendor says 6ft max for banner to avoid sightline violations
3) Power requirements for charging islands — vendor flagged a 20A 120V circuit per island
4) Crew arrival windows for concierge and rollout crates (we have a tight 4-hour load-in window)

I've also attached a baseline crew checklist (Excel) that the site will expect on arrival. Please review and confirm by EOD Thursday so I can lock the layout with AV and venue.

Attachments: pop-up-lounge-floorplan-v3.pdf, crew-checklist-v2.xlsx

Best,
Emily Huang
Event Manager | GreenHall Events
emily@greenhall-events.com | +1 415-555-0142

----
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Emily Huang <emily@greenhall-events.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, logan_wright@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pop-up lounge draft layout + shared crew checklist

Thanks Emily — overall looks great. A few quick Qs before we lock: 

1) Sightlines: can we flip the demo pedestal so the presenter faces the aisle rather than the interior of the lounge? That will help capture walk-by traffic without blocking the sofa sightlines.
2) Power: 20A per island sounds like a lot. Can AV confirm continuous draw and whether shared circuits are possible? If each island is 20A we may need an upgraded feed (3-phase?) or allocate a small UPS per island.
3) Flooring: vendor notes the venue requires flame-retardant carpeting and a 2" tapered ramp for the carpet edge to the concrete. Is that already included in your quote?
4) Crew: we need the concierge team of 3 onsite 45 minutes before demo start to stage giveaways and monitor chargers. Can we add that to the checklist?

I'm attaching our updated crew checklist with Redwood-specific items (insurance certificate on file, two-point sign-off for branded material, and a strictly enforced demo script for the pedestal). Can you confirm the arrival window for crates so we can advise our freight partner?

Attachments referenced: crew-checklist-v2.xlsx (Emily), crew-checklist-redwood-v1.xlsx (Karthik; attached inline)

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0199

----
From: Sam Ortiz <ops@avrentals.com>
To: Emily Huang <emily@greenhall-events.com>, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: logan_wright@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pop-up lounge draft layout + shared crew checklist

Hi all,

Looping in AV ops on the power Qs. Quick answers: 
- The charging islands at 20A each are based on a worst-case fully loaded estimate. In practice, we can spec them at 10A with intelligent power strips and per-port current limiting.
- Venue main feed for this hall is single-phase 208V; larger 3-phase is available only at the service riser (additional labor and cost).
- Recommend UPS for the demo pedestal (1 kVA) and per-island PDUs to avoid tripping during peak.

We can supply the UPS and PDUs. Need a final floorplan by Friday so we can pre-label drops and schedule patch cords.

Sam Ortiz
Site Operations | AV Rentals Co.
ops@avrentals.com | +1 503-555-0088
Attachment: av-power-estimate.pdf

----
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, Emily Huang <emily@greenhall-events.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pop-up lounge draft layout + shared crew checklist

Signed off from my side for the layout with two small asks: 
- Replace one sofa with two armchairs to open sightlines for accessibility and traffic flow.
- Banner artwork must use the "Redwood Blue" hex code (I attached brand spec).

Emily — please confirm banner tolerances (6ft max) and confirm carpet ramp plan. Once AV confirms 10A per island and labels drops we'll be good to go.

Marissa Cole
Senior Events Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-6622
Attachment: redwood-brand-guidelines.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Emily Huang <emily@greenhall-events.com>, Sam Ortiz <ops@avrentals.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, logan_wright@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, Freight Coordinator <freight@fedex.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2026 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pop-up lounge draft layout + shared crew checklist

Thanks team — final confirmation:
- Marissa approved (swap one sofa for two armchairs) — noted.
- AV: proceed with 10A per charging island + UPS for pedestal (Sam confirmed). Please send final power manifest and label map by EOD Thursday.
- Emily: please confirm carpet ramp and banner tolerance (6ft max). Also confirm you have Redwood's insurance cert (attached) for the venue.
- Freight: crates inbound to Loading Door B, ETA 11/18 08:00-10:00; on-site contact Logan Wright (650-555-0177). Please confirm the forklift availability and escort plan.

Next steps: Emily to upload signed floorplan and send DocuSign for the AV labor order (DocuSign EnvelopeID: 0F1A2B3C4D). Logistics team will run a 30-minute dry run on 11/18 at 10:30 after crates are staged.

Thanks — Karthik

Karthik Iyer
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
